name: spectral_s1b_material_effect_replication
status: proposed revised design; no S1b seeds drawn; later-pass review and implementation approval required
builds_on: configs/spectral_s1_pilot.json v0.2; S1 pilot NO-GO remains binding
execution_order: round-robin over i_rep across all sizes and families
seed_rule: np.random.SeedSequence([seed_base, i_family, i_size, i_rep]) with PCG64; sources from a child of the same sequence (as S1)
controls: S1 v0.2 P0a-P0d unchanged, STOP gates

outcomes.ci_type: Welch-Satterthwaite, tree-level delta method; fixed-n normal-theory nominal coverage only
outcomes.partial_verdict: BLOCKED per incomplete family; never classify confirmatory outcomes from partial data
outcomes.dual_equivalence_s2: may draft reviewed S2 only if C-EQUIVALENT and U-EQUIVALENT; not powered for this outcome
outcomes.stop_failure: no S2; do not interpret failure of equivalence test as non-equivalence

budget.notes: CPU estimates are based on pilot timings; 2^14 per-tree estimate unmeasured; no partial inferential verdict

primary_question: CAY 2^18 minus 2^16 slope difference materially > +0.03 on fresh seeds at W=128..1024
secondary_question: UST size-contrast descriptive; equivalence is underpowered and not a balanced S2 gate
